item.tib: sbyin sreg gtor ma'i yig chung
item.coloph: de ltar gcod gdams yid bzhin nor/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gzhung dag dang / man ngag ma bu'i tshangs ba 'di/ drung mu ha ra khyod la gtad/ las ldan byung na tshad ma sbyin/ yi ger bkod pa gnyer du bzhes/ gtang bzhag tshod mkhas zhes (gnyer) dam mdzod/ ma bu them 'grel tshang ma rnams/ sems dpa' brgyad la gdams par bya/ gzhan dag sems dge spyod btsan la/ ma bu che res rgyud smin nus/ khyad par gsang sde'i bon skor la/ 'di las dmar ba yod re kan/ u ya rma zhi e ma ho/ zhes gsungs te g.yu bya khu byug gcig tu sprul nas 'ja' yal pa ltar gshegs so//
